stories.summary: Before the release of a new documentary, the unrepentant Manchester United icon reflects on his deep bond with English football and his darker instincts “I’m an angel and a demon,” Éric Cantona says intently during a gripping new documentary about his life on and off the football pitch. “And an angel or a demon, you love him or you hate him. I’m far from being the person with the greatest integrity. I’m far from being the person who always tells the truth. I’m far from being the person who has never been hypocritical.
